payload.explanation: Install and enable Numpad Shortcuts 0.3.0 to add number-pad window movement, consolidation controls, and a panel that explains the workspace model and shortcuts.

reference.source_description: MIT-licensed public plugin revision verified on the repository's main branch

payload.effects: The unsandboxed plugin registers dynamic compositor bindings and provides a shell panel. Consolidation protection is temporary and applies only to consolidation operations.
payload.rollback: Disable and remove the plugin, restart Omarchy Shell, and reload the compositor so its dynamic bindings are absent.
payload.validation_plan: Validate the plugin and QML, test guide toggle and dismissal, inspect all expected live bindings, exercise representative workspace actions, and test multi-monitor behavior physically when more than one monitor is available.

activation.details: Restart Omarchy Shell after enabling the plugin so its service and panel load cleanly.
